upstream.description: A macOS app that pins usage limits from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity to a screen edge.

classification.analysis: Codenotch is a macOS menu-bar/notch app (with a Rust/Tauri Windows port) that shows live usage-limit rings for AI coding assistants -- Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity, GLM, Grok, OpenCode, and GitHub Copilot -- pinned to a screen edge. It reads whatever credential or local session each tool already holds (no separate sign-in), shows per-provider status (running, waiting on you, blocked) with a peek-and-sound alert when a session ends or needs input, and fires notifications at 80%/100% of a provider's usage window. It targets developers juggling several AI coding tool subscriptions who want a persistent, at-a-glance usage HUD instead of switching apps to check `/usage`.

use_cases.title: Watch Claude Code / Cursor / Codex usage limits at a glance without switching apps
Get alerted when an AI coding session finishes or is blocked waiting on you
Track separate work and personal Claude Code accounts side by side
Jump straight to the app behind a finished or stuck agent session
